title: Track the claimed DTNA plant-launch advisory opportunity?
detail: A personal LinkedIn InMail received October 30 proposes a potential Senior Advisor opportunity for greenfield plant launch readiness, assembly quality and manufacturing performance, claiming Daimler Truck North America affiliation. It explicitly describes a potential initiative rather than an established formal vacancy. No matching role exists in the fresh master/archive; location, requisition, compensation and sender affiliation remain unverified. Targeted public role search found no exact posting. This has not been added or counted as an applied-job recruiter contact.
blocks: Only creation of this separate advisory lead; independent pipeline work continues.
options: Add as an unverified advisory lead
recommended: Tim chooses whether to pursue; retain unverified status until employer and role context are established.
action: Answer whether to add this advisory lead. No application or outreach will be sent.
